newsitem.title: USA: Cost Plus June same-store sales up 5.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cost Plus June same-store sales up 5.4 pct.

text.p: Cost Plus Inc Thursday said same store sales for the five weeks ended July 5 rose 5.4 percent from the year-ago period.
Total sales for the five-weeks were $18.4 million, a 15.7 percent increase from $15.9 million last year.
Same-store sales for the twenty-two week period ended July 5, 1997 rose 6.8 percent, with total sales increasing 21 percent to $81.2 million from $67.1 million in the comparable period last year.
As of July 5, 1997, the company operated 60 stores compared with 52 stores as of July 6, 1996.
